messages:
maria: T-minus 45 for the midnight cutover. Quick preflight — can folks ack readiness and any last-minute pins? :wave:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2026-03-21T00:00Z -> release/2026-03-21. Canary group: 5%. Hooks: smoke, latency-check. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/2026-03-21

alex: Ack. I pushed the pin for v3.4.2 -> stable (k8s config updated). Command used: `kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:v3.4.2 --record`

kevin: Smoke tests running on canary now — initial pass on auth, embeddings, and chat. Latency is +12ms p50, within SLO. Reporting in 2m.

sarah: Rollback criteria reminder: 1) error rate > 1.5% for 3m, 2) latency p95 > 500ms for 5m, 3) any customer-facing 5xx surge. If triggered, ops-oncall executes rollback and posts reason.

ops-oncall: I'm standing by. I have the rollback command ready: `deploy-bot rollback --release previous --reason "canary-failure"` — will notify #incidents if executed.

kevin: Canary smoke finished: auth ok, embeddings throughput steady, one transient 502 on reranker but retried OK. Metrics: error_rate=0.23%, p95=320ms. Proceeding to slow ramp to 20%.

maria: Good. Reminder: freeze period in effect from T-30 to T+60. No schema migrations, no config toggles except pinned emergency flags.

alex: Pinned model variants validated — fallback variant (quantized) is ready at model:v3.4.2-quant for automatic fallback.

sarah: Ops checklist complete: alerting verifies helm-health, latency-alert, token-cost spike detector. Slack runbook link: https://docs.redwood/ops/runbooks/cutover.md

deploy-bot: Canary ramp: 5% -> 10% -> 20%. Next step in ~4m. Canary metrics link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/abc123/canary-2026-03-21

kevin: At 20%: p50 58ms, p95 340ms, error_rate 0.4%. No anomalous traces. Going to full ramp to 50% in 3m.

maria: Confirming release notes snippet posted to #release-notes: "v3.4.2: latency & reranker bugfix; embeddings perf improvement; rollback-safe pinning."

ops-oncall: Noted. Keeping watch on customer alerts. Will escalate immediately if thresholds hit.

kevin: At 50%: small spike in p95 to 420ms on one pod, autoscaler added an instance, stabilized. Error rate steady 0.6%. No rollback.

sarah: Decision: continue to 100% steady ramp. If we see error_rate >= 1.0% for 2 consecutive 5m windows we stop and roll back.

maria: Final note — if anyone needs a manual unpin, tag me and @ops-oncall. Otherwise, I will mark the deploy as complete at T+15 if no incidents. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: release/2026-03-21 rolled to 100%. Change window: midnight quiet. Summary: canary -> full, no rollback. Details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/2026-03-21/summary

kevin: Post-deploy smoke: all checks green. Sampling traces look clear.

ops-oncall: Handback to SRE shift lead scheduled at T+60. Posting runbook entries and latency baseline snapshot.

maria: Thanks team — closing this thread. If anything pops, reopen or start a new thread with incident tag. :sparkles:
